content: AI advisor anti-patterns for non-technical users: (1) HALLUCINATION TRUST — non-technical users accept AI output as authoritative; mitigation: always anchor LLM narrative to specific data points ('Seu TACoS de 18% está acima da meta de 12% nos últimos 7 dias'), never let LLM invent numbers; (2) OVER-AUTOMATION — auto-executing recommendations without approval destroys trust when wrong; mitigation: propose→approve→execute is non-negotiable for destructive actions; (3) NARRATIVE OVERLOAD — a wall of text for every insight overwhelms non-technical users; mitigation: 2-3 sentences max, bold the key metric, expand on demand; (4) CONFIDENCE WITHOUT EVIDENCE — presenting LLM output without citing the underlying data; mitigation: attach insight IDs/data citations to every LLM paragraph; (5) FEATURE CREEP — adding 'ask me anything' chat to an advisor panel; mitigation: keep it scoped to interpreting existing insights, not open-ended Q&A.
